in_marathi.name: Atharva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atharva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Atharva is a name derived from the ancient Indian texts, the Atharvaveda. It is associated with the god Atharva, who is considered the deity of knowledge, wisdom, and prosperity. The name is believed to bring blessings of knowledge, intelligence, and understanding.
